name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri Volkov's journey into the high-octane world of motorsport finance was somewhat accidental. Originally trained as an accountant in Moscow, he found himself drawn to the strategic complexities of managing finances within a competitive environment. He started in a small rally team, where he quickly learned the importance of meticulous planning and resource allocation. His knack for identifying cost-saving measures without compromising performance caught the attention of larger organizations.

He joined Andretti Global five years ago, bringing with him a wealth of experience in financial modeling and risk management. Dimitri's approach is rooted in a deep understanding of the motorsport industry's unique financial challenges. He believes in building strong relationships with all departments, ensuring that financial decisions are aligned with the team's overall objectives. What sets Dimitri apart is his ability to remain calm and collected under pressure, a crucial trait in the fast-paced world of racing. He's known for his methodical approach and unwavering commitment to accuracy.

His dedication to fiscal responsibility, coupled with his understanding of the sport, makes him an invaluable asset. He is committed to ensuring Andretti Global's long-term financial health and competitiveness on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Dimitri is of average height with a slightly stocky build, and a kind, but serious face.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus in his pocket, even though he primarily uses spreadsheets.
Insists on drinking black tea with lemon at precisely 3:00 PM every day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
